lines.text: Pewter City:\nA Stone Gray City
Pewter Museum of Science
Pewter City Pokémon Gym\nGym Leader: Brock\r\nThe Rock-Solid Pokémon Trainer!

Trainer Tips\c
All the Pokémon in your team can earn
Exp. Points, even if they don’t fight in a battle.\c
But if you do switch them into a battle, even
just for a moment, they’ll get more Exp. Points!

There’s a notice posted here...\c
“There have been reports recently of thieves
stealing valuable Pokémon Fossils on Mt. Moon.\c
“Please call the Pewter Police if you have any
information or see anything suspicious.”

Have you heard the stories that say Clefairy
come from the moon?\c
People started seeing them after Moon Stones
fell on Mt. Moon.

There aren’t many serious Pokémon Trainers
here in Pewter City.\c
They’re all Bug Catchers and the like.
You know, just hobbyists.\c
But Brock at the Pewter City Gym isn’t like that—
not one bit.
Did you check out the museum already?
The display of those Fossils found on Mt. Moon\nwas really something, wasn’t it?
Really?\nYou absolutely have to go!
Pssssssssst!\nDo you know what I’m doing?
That’s right—anyone can tell just by looking!\nAnd it’s hard work, too!
I’m spraying Repel around to keep wild Pokémon\nout of my flower beds!
Pssssssssst!\nDo you know what I’m doing?
That’s right—anyone can tell just by looking!\nAnd it’s hard work, too!
I’m spraying Lure around to get wild Pokémon\nto come visit my flower beds!
CATERPIE: Pi?
This is my sweet little Fre!\c\nWhen she walks with me, she sometimes finds\nitems in the field!
FRE: Freee!
Ahhh, it’s so refreshing...\c\nPewter City stays lovely and cool since it lies\nat the base of the mountain.
GEODUDE: Duuude...

You should be careful with your money.
Don’t go blowing it all in one place.\c
But it’s also fun sometimes to buy a whole
bunch of Poké Balls at once! Hahaha!
Wow... I wanna do that!\nI wanna ride on a Pokémon!
